# Mabel Colby

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c15 P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 c15 P2](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0002)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher and student  <sub>[v1 c26 P9](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0009), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c35 P5](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0005)</sub>

## Appearance

Mabel Colby is a striking, dark-eyed young woman who is considered the 'rose-red' girl among her peers. She has a beautiful, rosy complexion and is regarded as the beauty of her Freshman class at Wexcombe College.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P2](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0002), [v1 c25 P6](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0006), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

## Personality

Mabel possesses a warm, yearning, and imaginative heart beneath her striking appearance. She is deeply passionate about her friendships, though she can occasionally be prone to moodiness or pessimistic reflections about the difficulties of life and boarding.

_Sources: [v1 c25 P6](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0006), [v1 c26 P9](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0009), [v1 c26 P13](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0013), [v1 c30 P31](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0031)_

## Traits

- Imaginative and passionate  <sub>[v1 c25 P6](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0006)</sub>
- Pessimistic at times  <sub>[v1 c26 P9](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0009)</sub>
- Dislikes boarding  <sub>[v1 c26 P9](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0009)</sub>

## Abilities

- Writing and storytelling  <sub>[v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021)</sub>
- Schoolteaching across multiple grades  <sub>[v1 c26 P9](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0009)</sub>

## Goals

- Earn a college degree at Wexcombe College  <sub>[v1 c26 P9](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0009), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011)</sub>
- Write a paper on the trials of a country schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c26 P9](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0009)</sub>

## History

Mabel Colby worked for two years as a rural schoolteacher across nine grades, during which she grew weary of the trials of teaching and boarding in the country. She decided to pursue higher education at Wexcombe College, entering as a Sophomore due to her prior studies. Wanting to avoid boardinghouses, she proposed that she, Nell Harcourt, and Honora Hollis rent a house together in Portmaris, managed by her Aunt Euphemia. Joined by Cressida Lindsay, the group moved into Tabby's Place on Linden Avenue. Mabel participated in the girls' Story Club, writing creative tales, and successfully progressed through her studies at Wexcombe, ultimately graduating alongside her friends.

_Sources: [v1 c26 P9](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0009), [v1 c26 P13](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0013), [v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c37 P24](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0024)_

## Background by volume

- Worked as an isolated rural schoolteacher prior to attending college  <sub>[v1 c26 P9](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0009)</sub>
- Has an aunt named Euphemia (Jamesina) who comes to manage their household in Portmaris  <sub>[v1 c26 P9](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0009), [v1 c26 P13](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0013)</sub>
